stem: In a survey, a random sample of 250 adults in Fromleigh were asked to fill in a questionnaire about their travel.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: It was found that 102 adults in the sample travel by bus. Find an approximate 90% confidence interval for the proportion of all the adults in Fromleigh who travel by bus.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The survey included a question about the amount, $x$ dollars, spent on travel per year. The results are summarised as follows.

$$n = 250 \qquad \sum x = 50\,460 \qquad \sum x^2 = 19\,854\,200$$

Find unbiased estimates of the population mean and variance of the amount spent per year on travel.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: A councillor wanted to select a random sample of houses in Fromleigh. He planned to select the first house on each of the 143 streets in Fromleigh.
parts.text: Explain why this would not provide a random sample.
